summary: Auto-generated templates take their permissions from AAP (users need permission on the job template); custom templates need permissions configured explicitly in the portal plus permission to run the job template in AAP.
questions: Where do I set permissions for portal templates?
Do auto-generated portal templates use AAP RBAC?
What permissions do custom self-service templates need?

answer_card.title: Portal template permissions
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Auto-generated templates**: permissions sync from AAP. Users need permission on the underlying AAP job template.
- **Custom templates**: configure permissions explicitly in self-service automation portal, **and** users need permission to run the job template in AAP.
